content.text: and pointed out that this is NOT  a race. Just have SemWaitableEvent::Set () save and restoire
errno. Then - IF its called inside a signal handler, it wont spoil (cuz any thread whose stack its running on is blcoked during call).
Tried a fix to SemWaitableEvent::Set () and documented that this is signal handler safe, and commented out the tsan workaround to test.
Got the bug to appear again, so re-enabled the tsan suppression. Rare enough (took almost 3 months to see again) - so may take a while to know if tsan supression works \;-)
It looks like I have the right suppression:
but I got the spurrious error again - 2019-04-04.
got failure again. Try changing suppression from

Instead of tsan suppressions in .supp file - which dont appear to work, REMOVING suppression. INSTEAD using

// use no_sanitize(thread) to workaround https://stroika.atlassian.net/browse/STK-677
Stroika_Foundation_Debug_ATTRIBUTE_NO_SANITIZE ("thread") 

in SignalHandlerRegistry::FirstPassSignalHandler_ - where it appears to be called, and in SemWaitableEvent::Set() where its actually called.
